_comment: Domain-solution reference registry. Each solution has a lifecycle_stage field: sourcing | extraction | enrichment | preparation | publishing | syndication | analytics | ml_modeling | survival_analysis. Triggers are column-name / value / query keywords. Edit freely — loaded at runtime by domain_detector.py.

_lifecycle_stages.sourcing: Identify and acquire raw data from source systems, suppliers, APIs, or sensors
_lifecycle_stages.extraction: Pull structured data from source systems via ETL, APIs, file parsing, or CDC
_lifecycle_stages.enrichment: Add value to data via taxonomy mapping, attribute augmentation, entity resolution, or standards alignment
_lifecycle_stages.preparation: Cleanse, normalise, deduplicate, validate, and transform data into analysis-ready form
_lifecycle_stages.publishing: Expose data as a data product, catalogue entry, golden record, or analytics-ready mart
_lifecycle_stages.syndication: Distribute data to downstream consumers, partners, channels, or marketplaces
_lifecycle_stages.analytics: Profile, report, segment, and surface insights from prepared data
_lifecycle_stages.ml_modeling: Build predictive, classification, regression, or clustering models
_lifecycle_stages.survival_analysis: Time-to-event modelling: churn, failure, retention, hazard

Master Data Management.name: Data Source Inventory
Master Data Management.description: Catalogue all source systems contributing to a master data domain, mapping attributes, update frequencies, and authority levels.

Master Data Management.name: Multi-Source Data Extraction
Master Data Management.description: Extract and stage records from multiple source systems into a common landing zone for matching and merging.

Master Data Management.name: Entity Resolution
Master Data Management.description: Identify and link records that refer to the same real-world entity across sources using probabilistic or deterministic matching.

Master Data Management.name: Golden Record Creation
Master Data Management.description: Merge matched records into a single authoritative golden record applying survivorship rules to resolve attribute conflicts.

Master Data Management.name: MDM Hub Publishing
Master Data Management.description: Publish the master data hub so downstream systems can consume verified golden records via API, event stream, or replication.

Master Data Management.name: Downstream Syndication
Master Data Management.description: Distribute master data updates to all registered downstream consumers — ERP, CRM, analytics, partner portals.

Master Data Management.name: Data Stewardship & Governance
Master Data Management.description: Monitor data quality, manage exception queues, and enforce business rules across the master data lifecycle.

Mechanical Components.name: Supplier Data Acquisition
Mechanical Components.description: Onboard supplier data sheets, ERP extracts, and manufacturer specification files as the raw input to product data management.

Mechanical Components.name: Technical Specification Extraction
Mechanical Components.description: Parse structured and semi-structured specification data from PDFs, HTML data sheets, and ERP records into a tabular attribute schema.

Mechanical Components.name: Product Attribute Enrichment
Mechanical Components.description: Classify components into taxonomy hierarchies (UNSPSC, eCl@ss), map to standards (IEC, ISO, DIN), and augment with missing attributes.

Mechanical Components.name: Product Data Cleansing & Normalisation
Mechanical Components.description: Standardise units (mm vs inch, V vs kV), resolve multi-value fields, remove duplicates, and validate against specification rules.

Mechanical Components.name: Product Catalogue Publishing
Mechanical Components.description: Publish verified, enriched product records to the PIM system or product catalogue with completeness gate enforcement.

Mechanical Components.name: Channel & Marketplace Syndication
Mechanical Components.description: Distribute product content to distributor portals, e-procurement platforms, and industrial marketplaces (Grainger, Fastenal, Amazon Business).

Mechanical Components.name: Product Data Quality
Mechanical Components.description: Assess and remediate specification completeness, grade compliance, and attribute consistency across mechanical component catalogues.

Mechanical Components.name: Fastener Selection & Compatibility
Mechanical Components.description: Match fastener specifications to application requirements and flag incompatible pairings.

Mechanical Components.name: Predictive Maintenance
Mechanical Components.description: Predict mechanical component wear or failure based on load cycles, material fatigue, and environmental exposure.

Industrial Equipment.name: Equipment Data Acquisition
Industrial Equipment.description: Acquire sensor streams, SCADA data, maintenance logs, and ERP asset records as the raw input to equipment analytics.

Industrial Equipment.name: Technical Specification Extraction
Industrial Equipment.description: Extract equipment specifications and performance parameters from manuals, ERP records, and sensor streams.

Industrial Equipment.name: Asset Attribute Enrichment
Industrial Equipment.description: Classify equipment against taxonomy (ISO 14224, UNSPSC), link to maintenance records, and append manufacturer specifications.

Industrial Equipment.name: Sensor Data Preparation
Industrial Equipment.description: Cleanse, resample, and normalise sensor time series — handle missing readings, outlier spikes, and sensor drift.

Industrial Equipment.name: Asset Data Publishing
Industrial Equipment.description: Publish a unified asset data product to the enterprise asset management system or operations data platform.

Industrial Equipment.name: Predictive Maintenance
Industrial Equipment.description: Predict equipment failure or maintenance needs before they cause downtime.

Industrial Equipment.name: Asset Performance Management
Industrial Equipment.description: Track OEE, MTBF, and MTTR to optimise asset utilisation and reliability.

Wellness.name: Wellness Data Acquisition
Wellness.description: Acquire data from wearables, validated assessment instruments (PHQ-9, GAD-7), nutrition logs, and EHR wellness records.

Wellness.name: Wellness Data Preparation
Wellness.description: Harmonise assessment scores across instrument versions, impute missing pillar data, and normalise units across devices.

Wellness.name: Wellness Risk Scoring
Wellness.description: Score individuals across the six wellness pillars to identify those at risk of wellness decline.

Wellness.name: Mental Health Screening
Wellness.description: Apply validated screening instruments (PHQ-9, GAD-7) to identify individuals at risk of depression or anxiety.

Wellness.name: Behaviour Change Analytics
Wellness.description: Track habit formation, relapse risk, and engagement trends across wellness programme participants.

Wellness.name: Population Health Profiling
Wellness.description: Segment a population by wellness pillar performance to prioritise programme resources.

Healthcare.name: Clinical Data Acquisition
Healthcare.description: Identify and acquire clinical data from EHR systems, claims feeds, lab results, ADT streams, and care coordination platforms.

Healthcare.name: HL7 / FHIR Data Extraction
Healthcare.description: Extract and parse HL7 v2 messages or FHIR resources into structured tabular form for downstream processing.

Healthcare.name: Clinical Attribute Enrichment
Healthcare.description: Enrich clinical records with ICD-10 coding, HCC risk grouping, patient identity matching across systems, and care episode linking.

Healthcare.name: Clinical Data Harmonisation
Healthcare.description: Normalise terminology (SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm), de-identify to HIPAA Safe Harbour or Expert Determination, and reconcile cross-system patient records.

Healthcare.name: Clinical Data Mart Publishing
Healthcare.description: Publish an analytics-ready clinical data mart or longitudinal patient record for reporting and modelling consumption.

Healthcare.name: Health Data Exchange
Healthcare.description: Distribute clinical data to payers, HIE networks, care coordination platforms, and public health registries.

Healthcare.name: Mortality Prediction
Healthcare.description: Predict which patients are at risk of dying within a care episode or defined time window.

Healthcare.name: Readmission Prediction
Healthcare.description: Identify patients likely to be readmitted to hospital within 30/60/90 days of discharge.

Healthcare.name: Length of Stay Modeling
Healthcare.description: Predict or analyse patient length of stay to support capacity planning and care pathway optimisation.

Healthcare.name: Clinical Risk Stratification
Healthcare.description: Score and tier patients by overall clinical risk across multiple conditions or episodes.

Healthcare.name: Claim Denial Management
Healthcare.description: Identify claims likely to be denied and surface root causes to reduce denial rate.

Healthcare.name: Care Pathway Analysis
Healthcare.description: Map and optimise clinical care pathways by analysing episode sequences and outcomes.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Member Roster Acquisition
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Acquire member roster files and enrollment data from GPO member facilities, regional health systems, and IDNs.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Contract & Spend Data Extraction
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Extract contract terms, pricing tiers, and purchasing transaction data from distributor and supplier systems.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Facility & Class of Trade Enrichment
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Classify facilities by Class of Trade (Acute, Ambulatory, Home Care), append geolocation, network affiliation, and ownership data.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Member Data Harmonisation
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Deduplicate member records, resolve member ID conflicts across joining events, and normalise membership dates.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: GPO Data Hub Publishing
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Publish a unified member and contract data hub accessible to analytics, contracting, and member services teams.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Member Portal & Supplier Syndication
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Distribute member and contract data to member-facing portals, supplier systems, and downstream analytics platforms.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Membership Churn Prediction
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Predict which GPO members are at risk of terminating membership within a defined time horizon.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Contract Penetration Analysis
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Measure and improve member purchasing compliance and contract utilisation by segment.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Member Segmentation
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Segment GPO members by class of trade, purchasing behaviour, or engagement to personalise outreach.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Network Growth Analysis
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Analyse member acquisition and retention trends to forecast GPO network size and composition.

Pharmaceutical.name: Clinical & Regulatory Data Acquisition
Pharmaceutical.description: Acquire trial data, real-world evidence, compound registries, and regulatory submission sources.

Pharmaceutical.name: Trial Data Extraction & Standardisation
Pharmaceutical.description: Extract clinical trial data from EDC systems and standardise to CDISC SDTM and ADaM formats.

Pharmaceutical.name: Compound & Indication Enrichment
Pharmaceutical.description: Enrich compound records with MeSH indication codes, ATC classification, and structure-activity annotations.

Pharmaceutical.name: Trial Data Harmonisation
Pharmaceutical.description: Resolve terminology inconsistencies, handle missing endpoint data, and prepare analysis-ready ADaM datasets.

Pharmaceutical.name: Regulatory Submission Dataset
Pharmaceutical.description: Package and publish analysis-ready datasets for FDA/EMA regulatory submission.

Pharmaceutical.name: Real-World Evidence Distribution
Pharmaceutical.description: Distribute de-identified real-world evidence datasets to health economics partners and registry systems.

Pharmaceutical.name: Clinical Trial Outcome Analysis
Pharmaceutical.description: Analyse efficacy, safety, and dropout patterns across trial phases.

Pharmaceutical.name: Adverse Event Detection
Pharmaceutical.description: Flag and characterise adverse drug reactions from trial or real-world data.

Pharmaceutical.name: Compound Screening
Pharmaceutical.description: Score or rank drug candidates by predicted efficacy or safety profile.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Supplier Content Acquisition
Retail & E-commerce.description: Onboard product content from suppliers via data pools (1WorldSync, Salsify), EDI feeds, or direct file uploads.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Order & Catalogue Data Extraction
Retail & E-commerce.description: Extract order history, product catalogue, and customer data from OMS, ERP, and e-commerce platforms.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Product Content Enrichment
Retail & E-commerce.description: Enrich product listings with taxonomy classification, SEO keywords, missing attributes, and AI-generated descriptions.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Content Normalisation & Deduplication
Retail & E-commerce.description: Standardise product titles, normalise units, merge duplicate SKUs, and validate required attributes before publishing.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Storefront & PIM Publishing
Retail & E-commerce.description: Publish enriched product records to the PIM system and push live to the storefront with completeness gates.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Channel Syndication
Retail & E-commerce.description: Distribute product content to Google Shopping, Amazon, comparison sites, B2B portals, and international marketplaces.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Customer Churn Prediction
Retail & E-commerce.description: Identify customers at risk of lapsing or reducing purchasing activity.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Demand Forecasting
Retail & E-commerce.description: Forecast product demand by SKU, category, or location to inform inventory planning.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Recommendation Engine
Retail & E-commerce.description: Personalise product recommendations based on purchase history and browsing behaviour.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Pricing & Promotions Analysis
Retail & E-commerce.description: Measure price elasticity and promotion effectiveness to optimise margin.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Credit Bureau & Applicant Data Acquisition
Financial Services / Lending.description: Pull credit bureau files (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion), bank statement feeds, and open banking data for underwriting.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Core Banking Data Extraction
Financial Services / Lending.description: Extract loan records, transaction history, and account data from core banking and loan origination systems.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Customer Profile Enrichment
Financial Services / Lending.description: Enrich borrower profiles with derived features (DTI, LTV, payment history trends) and third-party data (property values, employment).

Financial Services / Lending.name: Loan Data Harmonisation
Financial Services / Lending.description: Standardise loan product codes, resolve borrower identity across origination and servicing systems, and clean performance fields.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Risk Data Mart Publishing
Financial Services / Lending.description: Publish analytics-ready credit risk and portfolio data mart for underwriting, pricing, and regulatory reporting.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Regulatory Reporting Submission
Financial Services / Lending.description: Package and submit required regulatory reports (HMDA, Call Report, Basel) to regulatory bodies on schedule.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Credit Risk Scoring
Financial Services / Lending.description: Score loan applicants or existing borrowers by probability of default or delinquency.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Fraud Detection
Financial Services / Lending.description: Identify fraudulent transactions or applications in real time or batch.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Portfolio Analytics
Financial Services / Lending.description: Monitor and report on loan portfolio quality, concentration, and performance trends.

Insurance.name: Policy & Claims Data Acquisition
Insurance.description: Acquire policy files, claims submissions, and third-party data (weather, property) from carriers, agents, and external sources.

Insurance.name: Policy & Claims Enrichment
Insurance.description: Append geospatial risk scores, vehicle valuations, and occupancy data to enrich underwriting and claims records.

Insurance.name: Claims Data Preparation
Insurance.description: Normalise claim type codes, resolve duplicate claims, validate coverage limits, and build loss triangles.

Insurance.name: Regulatory Submission
Insurance.description: Submit rate filings, loss runs, and statutory financial statements to state regulators and reinsurers.

Insurance.name: Claims Analytics
Insurance.description: Analyse claim frequency, severity, and loss ratio to inform pricing and reserving.

Insurance.name: Fraud Detection
Insurance.description: Score claims for suspected fraud or abuse before payment.

Insurance.name: Premium Optimisation
Insurance.description: Model risk factors to price premiums more accurately by segment.

HR & People Analytics.name: HR System Data Acquisition
HR & People Analytics.description: Acquire employee records from HRIS, ATS, payroll, and engagement survey platforms.

HR & People Analytics.name: People Data Harmonisation
HR & People Analytics.description: Resolve employee IDs across systems, normalise job grades and department codes, and reconcile hire/termination dates.

HR & People Analytics.name: HR Data Publishing
HR & People Analytics.description: Publish a unified people data mart for workforce analytics, compensation benchmarking, and DE&I reporting.

HR & People Analytics.name: Attrition Prediction
HR & People Analytics.description: Identify employees at risk of leaving to support retention planning.

HR & People Analytics.name: Compensation Analysis
HR & People Analytics.description: Audit pay equity and model compensation structures across levels and demographics.

HR & People Analytics.name: Workforce Planning
HR & People Analytics.description: Model headcount needs, hiring pipeline, and span-of-control targets.

Travel & Hospitality.name: Property & Rate Data Acquisition
Travel & Hospitality.description: Acquire hotel property content, rate and availability feeds from GDS systems, OTAs, and direct channel managers.

Travel & Hospitality.name: Booking & Pricing Data Extraction
Travel & Hospitality.description: Extract booking records, rate history, and occupancy data from PMS and reservation systems.

Travel & Hospitality.name: Destination Attribute Enrichment
Travel & Hospitality.description: Enrich destination records with experience scores, seasonal profiles, safety ratings, and cost-of-travel indices.

Travel & Hospitality.name: Rate & Content Normalisation
Travel & Hospitality.description: Normalise rate currency, resolve property duplicate IDs, validate room type codes, and harmonise amenity classifications.

Travel & Hospitality.name: OTA Listing Publication
Travel & Hospitality.description: Publish verified property content and rates to OTA platforms and direct booking channels.

Travel & Hospitality.name: GDS & Meta-Search Syndication
Travel & Hospitality.description: Distribute rates and availability to GDS networks (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport) and meta-search engines (Google Hotels, Trivago).

Travel & Hospitality.name: Revenue Management Analytics
Travel & Hospitality.description: Optimise room pricing, occupancy, and RevPAR using demand patterns and competitor rate intelligence.

Education.name: Student Data Acquisition
Education.description: Acquire student records from SIS, LMS, assessment platforms, and attendance systems.

Education.name: Student Data Preparation
Education.description: Resolve student IDs across systems, normalise grade scales, and validate enrollment and cohort assignments.

Education.name: At-Risk Student Identification
Education.description: Flag students at risk of dropping out or failing based on attendance and performance signals.

Education.name: Course Effectiveness Analysis
Education.description: Measure the impact of courses, instructors, and interventions on student outcomes.

General.name: Data Pipeline Design
General.description: Design end-to-end data pipeline from source identification through to publishing for an unspecified domain.

General.name: Exploratory Data Analysis
General.description: Profile, summarise, and surface patterns in an unfamiliar dataset.
